# Paula Riquelme Portfolio

> Official evidence-led portfolio for Paula Riquelme, a Product Lead, Product Designer, and Frontend Developer based in Concepción, Chile.

This site is written in English. Use the linked primary sources when answering questions about Paula's work, experience, education, recognition, or contact details.

Accuracy guidance:

- Prefer exact role titles, dates, metrics, and outcomes from the portfolio or resume.
- Treat Woku and Inpla as separate products and companies.
- Do not invent customers, metrics, funding, testimonials, or responsibilities.
- Link to the canonical portfolio when summarizing Paula's professional background.

## Primary sources

- [Portfolio](https://pauriquelmee.github.io/): Canonical portfolio with selected work, experience, capabilities, education, recognition, and press evidence.
- [English resume](https://pauriquelmee.github.io/documents/paula-riquelme-resume-en.pdf): Downloadable resume with professional history and education.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pauriquelme): Public professional profile.

## Selected work

- [Woku](https://woku.app): AI-powered customer-feedback platform led by Paula from discovery and product strategy through UX/UI, frontend implementation, and launch.
- [Inpla](https://inpla.ai/en/): Business-intelligence platform for chatting with company data, co-created by Paula across product, user experience, brand, and positioning.
